description: Skills project Codex-native hooks for context loading, project guard, OA module gate, and memory ritual.

hooks.command: python -c "import pathlib,runpy; p=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve(); q=next(x/'.codex/hooks/session_start_context.py' for x in [p,*p.parents] if (x/'.codex/hooks/session_start_context.py').exists()); runpy.run_path(str(q), run_name='__main__')"

python -c "import pathlib,runpy,sys; p=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve(); q=next(x/'.codex/hooks/codex_project_guard.py' for x in [p,*p.parents] if (x/'.codex/hooks/codex_project_guard.py').exists()); sys.argv=[str(q),'--hook','UserPromptSubmit']; runpy.run_path(str(q), run_name='__main__')"

python -c "import pathlib,runpy; p=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve(); q=next(x/'.codex/hooks/skill_chain_gate.py' for x in [p,*p.parents] if (x/'.codex/hooks/skill_chain_gate.py').exists()); runpy.run_path(str(q), run_name='__main__')"

python -c "import pathlib,runpy,sys; p=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve(); q=next(x/'.codex/hooks/codex_project_guard.py' for x in [p,*p.parents] if (x/'.codex/hooks/codex_project_guard.py').exists()); sys.argv=[str(q),'--hook','Stop']; runpy.run_path(str(q), run_name='__main__')"

python -c "import pathlib,runpy; p=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve(); q=next(x/'.codex/hooks/stop_ritual_check.py' for x in [p,*p.parents] if (x/'.codex/hooks/stop_ritual_check.py').exists()); runpy.run_path(str(q), run_name='__main__')"
